injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.detail: Ingram (Achilles) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game at Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.detail: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Cam Christie
injuries.detail: Christie is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Suns due to a right ankle sprain, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
injuries.detail: Antetokounmpo is probable for Tuesday's game against the Jazz due to a right wrist sprain.

injuries.name: Tyler Herro
injuries.detail: Herro (contusion) is listed as questionable for Tuesday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Kel'el Ware
injuries.detail: Ware is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Knicks due to a left ankle sprain.

injuries.name: Josh Hart
injuries.detail: Hart is doubtful for Tuesday's game against the Bucks due to an illness.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMaho

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Trail Blazers.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Suggs
injuries.detail: Suggs (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Tristan da Silva
injuries.detail: Da Silva is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Kings due to a left calf strain.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.detail: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.detail: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.detail: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

injuries.name: Adem Bona
injuries.detail: Bona (back) is out for Tuesday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.detail: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Keyonte George
injuries.detail: George (ankle) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.detail: Markkanen is out for Tuesday's game versus the Heat with a right wrist sprain.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.
